directory_policies.notes.4: English policy: Graduate minimums: legacy TOEFL 80, new TOEFL 4, IELTS 6.5, DET 115 and PTE 53. Scores must remain valid for entrance; program expectations, waivers and unsupported test formats need review.

fact_summary: The graduate policy lists distinct test scales and entrance-anchored validity. It remains policy context pending complete program-specific assessment.
